name: HabitLens
shortDescription: A personal habit-tracking app designed to make logging quick and help users understand progress over time.
overview: HabitLens is a Flutter and Dart application focused on practical habit recording and trend discovery. It supports different input styles so users can track simple completion and measurable goals. The project is being developed iteratively, with a focus on reliable data handling and clear statistics.
objectives: Support several habit input types without making daily logging complicated.
Keep habit recording separate from progress analysis.
Present daily, weekly, and monthly progress in a useful format.
Allow users to correct or remove historical entries.
role: Designed and developed the application as an independent project.
features: Checkbox, numeric-goal, counter, and rating-based habits
challenges: Supporting multiple habit types requires consistent validation and statistics across different input formats.
Statistics must interpret each habit type correctly, including counters whose logged values can exceed a target.
learnings: Structuring a Flutter app around reusable data models and services
Testing storage and statistics across multiple habit types
Iterating on requirements to keep daily logging simple
results: HabitLens is a completed Flutter habit-tracking application developed independently. Its features include multiple habit input types, progress statistics, habit customisation, and light and dark themes. The source code is publicly available on GitHub.
